title: Cohere and PwC partnership announcement | Cohere
gist: PwC and Cohere announced a global alliance, launching first in Canada, pairing Cohere's North agentic platform and models with PwC's advisory expertise. The pitch centers on secure deployment, including private cloud, on-prem and air-gapped options.

themes.theme: Channel partnership with a Big Four firm

insights.claim: Cohere is distributing its enterprise AI stack through a global alliance with PwC, launching first in Canada, using PwC's industry, risk, regulatory and transformation expertise as the go-to-market channel.
insights.speaker: @cohere
insights.so_what: Consulting-led distribution is how Cohere reaches regulated enterprises, and the Canada-first launch signals a home-market beachhead.

insights.claim: The alliance is framed around turning AI investment into measurable business value, implying buyers still struggle to show ROI from AI spend and that services firms are positioning to fill that gap.
insights.speaker: @cohere
insights.so_what: Enterprise AI demand is shifting from experimentation to ROI justification, which favors vendors with services partners.
insights.quote: turn AI investment into measurable business value

insights.claim: Deployment options include private cloud, on-premises and air-gapped environments, so organizations can keep control over sensitive data and infrastructure while scaling AI.
insights.speaker: @cohere
insights.so_what: Cohere competes on deployment flexibility for regulated and data-sensitive buyers rather than on hyperscaler-hosted APIs.
insights.quote: private cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments
insights.locator: Clients will be able to apply AI

insights.claim: The joint offering includes governance and controls for responsible deployment at scale, plus secure connection of AI to trusted enterprise data and systems, treating governance as a core part of the product.
insights.speaker: @cohere
insights.so_what: Compliance and risk tooling is becoming a purchase criterion, which benefits vendors paired with audit and risk advisors.
insights.locator: Together, PwC and Cohere will help

insights.claim: The stack combines North (Cohere's secure agentic AI platform), enterprise models, and search and retrieval, with use cases across enterprise search, knowledge access, deep research, decision support and task automation.
insights.speaker: @cohere
insights.so_what: Cohere is positioning around retrieval-centric agentic workflows, not general consumer chat.
